NASA plans a crewed mission by early 2028 to establish a sustained human presence on the Moon! But what if you actually moved into a lunar habitat? To survive extreme radiation and space dust, astronaut homes would be built under thick domes 3D-printed from melted Moon dust. Mined lunar ice from frozen south pole craters would supply drinking water and rocket fuel. With days lasting two weeks, giant solar towers on high crater rims would catch endless sunlight. Would you spend a year living on the Moon? Follow for more what-ifs.

Based on today's news: NASA plans crewed surface mission by early 2028 for sustained lunar presence
